_source: Verbatim strings for pototype/boq.jsx BOQEditor (L362-848) + BOQEditorRow (L857-919) + BOQItemForm (L922-1035) + boq-extra.jsx BudgetControlBar (L201-258) that do NOT have a dedicated boq.ed* DICT key. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as boq-overview-strings.json / boq-strings.json. Each value is a REAL i18n key: navBoqEditor / navBoqList are nav_i18n labels (tn); every other value is a phrases-bucket key (tp) where the Thai phrase IS the key, verified present in docs/extract/i18n-full.json (phrases). The boq.ed* DICT keys cover the titles/labels/toasts/templates and are used via t(). No string here is invented (§0 rule 2).
